title: fix(cli): reject reserved keys in provider and MCP assignments
body:
## What Problem This Solves

`__proto__` assignments silently disappear when saving provider environment or MCP environment/header settings.

Supersedes #172325, thanks @wangmiao0668000666.

## User Impact

`--provider-env`, MCP `--env`, and MCP `--header` now reject `__proto__`, `constructor`, and `prototype` with a clear error before saving config. Ordinary keys and literal values retain their behavior. No migration is required.

## Why This Change Was Made

Both command families now use one KEY=VALUE parser and the existing `isBlockedObjectKey` guard used by config paths. This removes the two duplicate parsers: **production LOC −7**. Diagnostics identify the flag and reserved key without disclosing values; malformed provider-env diagnostics now use the same wording as MCP.

The extra 48 test lines cover all three reserved keys at all three CLI entry points, unchanged MCP config, provider secret redaction, and normal provider values (including empty values and embedded `=`). A dedicated test-line allocation records that regression coverage.

## Evidence

- Baseline: `6a82c555d2d433e02b3a95c76e7414b0698ff186`; both parsers assign into ordinary objects. String-valued `__proto__` input is silently dropped, rather than demonstrating global prototype mutation.
- Crabbox/Testbox: all nine reserved-key cases fail on the main parser bytes and pass with the fix. [MCP red/green](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41498739305): 42 MCP tests pass (35.10 s wall time). [Provider replay](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41500457757) uses owned command fixtures and proves all three main commands complete instead of rejecting reserved keys.
- [Final focused checks](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41501287506): 66 provider/config tests pass (67.06 s wall time, including 86% transform overhead), touched-file lint reports zero warnings/errors. MCP coverage uses the real state owner and config writes; its existing integration file exceeds 30 s. The new tests add no sleeps.
- Touched-file format check flagged one 101-character MCP call; it is now wrapped mechanically. PR CI will verify final formatting and supply broad proof.
- Final local autoreview (requested route), base above through the complete working-tree candidate, P0–P2: **scoped-clean**, no actionable findings. Tests were independently controlled in Crabbox.
- Contributor code was read with `gh pr view/diff` only and was never checked out or executed. This is a maintainer-authored replacement.
- PR CI supplies broad proof. No broad suites, worker compilation, dependency install, containers, or Gateway changes were run on the production Team host for the focused proof.
